expectations.text: No intent file created for a purely technical upgrade
Final message explains there is no business need behind it
expectations.evidence:
I didn't write an intent for this, and I didn't create or change any files.

An intent records a business need: someone in the business (a Rider, an Investor, Fleet Operations) wants something, and the intent says why. Upgrading Spring Boot from 4.1 (currently `4.1.1` in `pom.xml`) to 4.2, and jMole
